The visit_Assert method (lines 257-260) does `self.complexity += not self.no_assert`. An assertion therefore adds 1 only when no_assert is False, and nothing when it is True. Nested visitors at lines 279 and 313 pass no_assert along. radon/complexity.py (B) is the caller that passes the option through. raw.py and metrics.py have no assert handling. I did not read the handoff_refs files.
